name: UAE Federal Labour Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021)
description: Employment terms under Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships, as amended: the articles an employment contract must meet. Applies to the private sector onshore and in the free zones without their own employment law. Verbatim MOHRE English text; the Arabic text prevails. DRAFT: not yet legally reviewed.

authority.name: Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation

clauses.title: Equality and Non-discrimination: no discrimination
clauses.content: Any discrimination on the basis of race, colour, sex, religion, national or social origin or disability which would have the effect of nullifying or impairing equality of opportunity, or prejudicing equal treatment in the employment, the maintenance of a job and the enjoyment of its benefits, is prohibited. Employers are prohibited to discriminate against workers in jobs involving similar tasks.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Equality and Non-discrimination: equal pay for women
clauses.content: A woman is granted a wage equal to the wages of a man if she performs the same work, or an alternative work of equal value. By a resolution of the Cabinet, upon the Minister’s proposal, the procedures, terms and standards necessary for evaluating work of equal value shall be issued.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Recruitment and Employment of Workers: no recruitment fees charged to the worker
clauses.content: The employer is prohibited from charging the worker for the fees and costs of recruitment and employment or collecting them from him, whether directly or indirectly.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Employment Contract: written contract in two copies
clauses.content: The employer shall conclude an employment contract with the worker, according to the agreed work pattern. The contract shall be made in two copies; one copy shall be kept by the employer and the other shall be handed over to the worker, as per the forms specified by the Implementing Regulation hereof.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Employment Contract: specified term
clauses.content: Contract of employment shall be concluded for a specified period of time, subject to renewal, in accordance with the agreement of both parties.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)
clauses.guidance: Every employment contract must be for a fixed, specified term (renewable by agreement); an open-ended (unlimited) term does not comply. No maximum term applies since the 2022 amendment.

clauses.title: Employment Contract: extension or renewal
clauses.content: In case of extending or renewing the contract, the new term(s) shall be considered an extension of the original term and shall be added to it while calculating the worker’s continuous term of service.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Employment Contract: implicit extension
clauses.content: If both parties continue to implement the contract after the expiry of its original term or the completion of the agreed work without an express agreement, the original contract is considered implicitly extended as per the same conditions set forth therein.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Probationary Period: at most six months
clauses.content: The employer may appoint the worker under a probationary period not exceeding (6) six months from the date of commencement of work. The employer may terminate the service of the worker during this period after notifying the latter of the same in writing fourteen (14) days at least before the date specified for the termination of service.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)
clauses.guidance: Probation may not exceed six months; the employer must give at least 14 days written notice to end employment during probation.

clauses.title: Probationary Period: only once per employer
clauses.content: It is not permissible to appoint a worker under probationary period more than once at one employer, and if the worker successfully passes the probationary period and continues to work, the contract shall become valid according to the agreed terms. This period shall be counted within the term of service.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Probationary Period: worker moving to another employer
clauses.content: If the worker wishes to move during the probationary period, to work for another employer in the State, he shall notify the original employer of the same in writing within not less than one month from the date of his wish to terminate the contract. Then, the new employer shall compensate the original employer for the costs of recruitment or contracting with the worker, unless otherwise agreed upon.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)
clauses.guidance: A worker leaving during probation to join another UAE employer gives at least one month written notice; the new employer, not the worker, compensates recruitment costs unless agreed otherwise.

clauses.title: Probationary Period: foreign worker leaving the State
clauses.content: If the foreign worker wishes to terminate the employment contract during the probationary period, to leave the State, he shall notify the employer of the same in writing not less than fourteen (14) days from the date specified for the termination of the contract. If he wishes to return to the State and obtain a new work permit within (3) three months from the date of departure, the new employer shall pay the compensation stipulated in Clause (3) of this Article, unless in case of an agreement between the worker and the original employer to the contrary.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Probationary Period: compensation for not observing notice
clauses.content: If either party terminates the employment contract without taking into consideration the provisions of this Article, it shall pay to the other party compensation equal to the worker’s wages for the notice period or the remaining period of the notice period.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Non-competition Clause: scope and two-year limit
clauses.content: If the work assigned to the worker allows him to gain knowledge of the employer’s clients or have access to its work secrets, the employer may require that the worker under the employment contract shall not, after the expiry of the contract, compete with the employer or be engaged in any competing project in the same sector, provided that the requirement is specified, in terms of time, place and type of work, to the extent necessary to protect the legitimate business interests. The non-competition period shall not be more than two years from the expiry date of the contract.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)
clauses.guidance: A post-employment non-compete is allowed only where the role gives access to clients or trade secrets, must be limited in time, place and type of work to what protects legitimate interests, and may not exceed two years after the contract ends.

clauses.title: Non-competition Clause: void after unlawful termination
clauses.content: This requirement shall be nullified if the employer terminates the employment contract in violation of the provisions hereof.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Assigning the Worker to Another Job: no fundamentally different work
clauses.content: The worker may not be assigned to undertake work that is fundamentally different from the work agreed upon in the employment contract, unless it is necessary in order to prevent the occurrence of an accident or to rectify the resulting damages, provided that the assignment is temporary and in accordance with what is specified in the Implementing Regulation hereof.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Assigning the Worker to Another Job: written consent for other work
clauses.content: In cases other than those mentioned in Clause (1) of this Article, the employer may assign the worker to undertake work not agreed upon in the employment contract, provided that the worker provides his consent in writing.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Assigning the Worker to Another Job: relocation costs
clauses.content: If the worker has to change his place of residence in order to be able to undertake work that is different from the work agreed upon in the employment contract, the employer shall bear all the financial costs arising therefrom, including the costs of the worker’s relocation and residence.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Employer’s Obligations: official documents
clauses.content: Not withholding the official documents of the worker or forcing him to leave the State at the end of the employment relationship;
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, January 2024)
clauses.guidance: The employer may not keep the worker’s passport or other official documents, nor force the worker to leave the UAE when employment ends.

clauses.title: Employer’s Obligations: accommodation or allowance
clauses.content: Providing the worker with proper accommodation licensed by the competent authorities in accordance with the rules, conditions and standards in force in the State, or paying to him an accommodation allowance in cash or including it in the wage;
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, January 2024)

clauses.title: Employer’s Obligations: medical care costs
clauses.content: Bearing the costs of the worker’s medical care in accordance with the legislation in force in the State;
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, January 2024)

clauses.title: Employer’s Obligations: experience certificate
clauses.content: Giving the worker, as per his request and upon expiry of the employment contract, a certificate of experience, without fees, indicating the date of his commencement of work, the date of its expiry, his entire service term, job title or type of work he was performing, the last wage he was receiving and the reason for the termination of the employment contract, provided that the certificate does not include anything that may harm the worker’s reputation or limit his chances of finding new job opportunities;
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, January 2024)

clauses.title: Employer’s Obligations: repatriation costs
clauses.content: Bearing the repatriation expenses of the worker to his place of recruitment or any other place that both parties had agreed upon, unless he has already joined the service of another employer or unless the reason for terminating the contract was attributed to the worker, then that the latter shall be liable for incurring those expenses;
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, January 2024)

clauses.title: Prohibition of Forced Labour and Other Prohibitions: forced labour
clauses.content: The employer shall not use any means that would oblige or force the worker, threaten him with any penalty to work for it, or compel him to undertake work or provide a service against his will.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Prohibition of Forced Labour and Other Prohibitions: harassment and violence
clauses.content: Sexual harassment, bullying or any verbal, physical or psychological violence committed against the worker by the employer, his superiors at work, colleagues or the persons who work with him, are prohibited.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Working Hours: maximum normal hours
clauses.content: The maximum normal working hours for workers shall be (8) eight hours per day or (48) forty-eight hours per week.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Working Hours: hours outside full-time work
clauses.content: If the worker works based on a pattern other than the full-time pattern, the original employer, or any other employer for which the worker works in accordance with the provisions hereof, may not ask the worker to work for it more than the hours agreed upon in the employment contract, except with the written consent of the worker.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Consecutive Working Hours
clauses.content: The worker may not work for more than (5) five consecutive hours without a break or breaks of not less than an hour in total, provided that these periods are not included in the working hours. Working hours and breaks shall be arranged at an establishment working according to shifts or for some job categories, as per their nature, such as field jobs, and according to the workers’ classification specified in the Implementing Regulation hereof.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Overtime: overtime limits
clauses.content: The employer may instruct the worker to work overtime over the normal working hours, provided that they do not exceed two hours per day. The worker may not be instructed to work for more than that period, except in accordance with the conditions and rules specified by the Implementing Regulation hereof. In all cases, the total working hours shall not exceed (144) one hundred and forty four hours every (3) three weeks.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Overtime: overtime pay
clauses.content: If the work conditions necessitate that the worker works for more than the normal working hours, the excess period shall represent overtime, for which the worker shall receive a wage equal to the wage corresponding to the normal working hours, which is calculated according to the basic wage plus an increase of not less than (25 %) twenty five percent of that wage.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)
clauses.guidance: Overtime pays at least the basic hourly wage plus 25%.

clauses.title: Overtime: night overtime pay
clauses.content: If the work conditions require that the worker works overtime between 10 pm and 4 am, the worker shall be entitled, regarding the overtime, to receive the wage prescribed for the normal working hours calculated according to the basic wage plus an increase of not less than (50 %) fifty percent of that wage. The workers working based on shifts shall be excluded from this clause.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Overtime: work on the weekend
clauses.content: If the circumstances require that the worker works on the weekend specified in the employment contract or work regulation, he shall be compensated with another day off or he shall be paid the wage of that day according to the wage established for normal working days, plus an increase of not less than (50 %) fifty percent of the basic wage for that day.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Overtime: consecutive weekends
clauses.content: A worker shall not be instructed to work for more than two consecutive weekend days, except for day workers.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Weekend
clauses.content: The worker shall be granted a paid weekend of not less than one day, according to the employment contract or the work regulation. It is permissible under a resolution of the Cabinet to increase the weekend day stipulated in this Article.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Defining the Amount or Type of Wage and its Payment: wage stated in the contract
clauses.content: The amount or type of wage shall be specified in the employment contract, and if it is not specified, the competent court shall specify it as a labour dispute.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Defining the Amount or Type of Wage and its Payment: paid on time
clauses.content: The employer shall pay the salaries or wages to its workers on their due dates in accordance with the regulations approved in the Ministry, as well as the conditions, rules and procedures specified by the Implementing Regulation hereof.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Defining the Amount or Type of Wage and its Payment: currency
clauses.content: The salaries shall be paid in UAE Dirham and may be paid in another currency if it is agreed upon between both parties in the employment contract.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Cases of Deduction or Withhold from the Worker’s Wage: permitted deductions
clauses.content:
No amount may be deducted or withheld from the worker’s wage except in the following cases:
a. The redemption of loans granted to the worker, within the maximum limit of the monthly deduction percentage from the worker’s wage stipulated in this Article, after obtaining the worker’s written consent and without any interest.
b. The redemption of the amounts paid to the worker in excess of his entitlements, provided that the amount deducted does not exceed (20%) twenty percent of the wage.
c. The amounts deducted for the purposes of calculating the contributions in bonuses, retirement pensions and insurances according to the legislation in force in the State.
d. The worker’s contributions to the Savings Fund at the establishment or the loans payable to the Fund approved by the Ministry.
e. Installments for any social project or any other benefits or services provided by the employer and approved by the Ministry, provided that the worker agrees in writing to participate in the project.
f. Amounts deducted from the worker due to violations he commits, according to the regulation of penalties in force at the establishment and approved by the Ministry, provided that they shall not exceed (5%) five percent of the wage.
g. Debts due pursuant to a judgment, without exceeding a quarter of the wage payable to the worker, except for the awarded alimony debt, as more than a quarter of the wage may be deducted. In case of several debts, the amounts to be paid shall be distributed as per the privilege categories.
h. Amounts necessary to rectify the damage caused by the worker, as a result of his mistake or violation of the employer’s instructions, which led to the destruction, demolition or loss of tools, machines, products or materials owned by the employer, provided that the deducted amounts do not exceed the wage of (5) five days per month. It is not permissible to deduct an amount greater than that except with the approval of the competent court.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)
clauses.guidance: Deductions from wages are allowed only in the listed cases and within their limits (for example, penalties at most 5% of the wage).

clauses.title: Cases of Deduction or Withhold from the Worker’s Wage: overall cap
clauses.content: If there are many reasons for deduction or withholding from the wage, in all cases the percentage of deduction and/or withholding may not exceed (50%) fifty percent of the wage.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Public Holidays and Employment of Workers Therein
clauses.content:
1. The worker shall be entitled to official days off with full pay on public holidays, which are defined by a resolution of the Cabinet.
2. If work conditions require that the worker works during any of the public holidays, the employer shall compensate him with another day off for each day, on which he works during the holiday, or pay him the wage for that day according to the wage established for the normal working days, plus an increase of not less than (50%) fifty percent of the basic wage for that day.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Annual Leave: entitlement
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, January 2024)
clauses.guidance: At least 30 days of paid annual leave for each year of service, two days per month after six months, and leave for part of the final year.

clauses.title: Annual Leave: during probation
clauses.content: The employer may agree to grant the worker a leave from his annual leave balance during the probationary period, while the worker shall reserve his right to be compensated for the remainder of his annual leave balance in case he does not pass the probationary period.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, January 2024)

clauses.title: Annual Leave: timing and notice
clauses.content: The worker shall obtain his leave in its entitlement year and the employer may specify the dates of these leaves according to work requirements and in agreement with the worker, or grant them alternately among the establishment’s workers, in order to secure its work progress. The employer shall notify the worker of the specified date for his leave within a sufficient time of not less than a month.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, January 2024)

clauses.title: Annual Leave: carrying leave forward
clauses.content: The worker may, with the approval of his employer and in accordance with the applicable regulations at the establishment, carry forward his annual leave balance or days thereof to the following year.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, January 2024)

clauses.title: Annual Leave: leave accrued over two years
clauses.content: The employer may not prevent the worker from benefiting from his annual leave accrued for more than two years, unless the worker wishes to carry it forward or receive a cash allowance for it, in accordance with the regulations in force at the establishment and the Implementing Regulation hereof.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, January 2024)

clauses.title: Annual Leave: pay for leave not taken
clauses.content: The worker shall be entitled to a wage for the accrued leave days if he quits the work before using them, regardless of the leave duration, with respect to the period for which he did not obtain his leave. He shall also be entitled to receive leave wage for parts of the year in proportion to the period he spent in work and it shall be calculated according to the basic wage.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, January 2024)

clauses.title: Maternity Leave: sixty days
clauses.content:
The female worker shall be entitled to a maternity leave of (60) sixty days, according to the following:
a. The first (45) forty-five days with full wage.
b. The following (15) fifteen days with half wage.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Maternity Leave: no termination for pregnancy or maternity
clauses.content: It is not permissible to terminate the service of the female worker or notify her of the same because of the pregnancy, having a maternity leave or her absence from work in accordance with the provisions of this Article.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Maternity Leave: nursing breaks
clauses.content: After returning from maternity leave and for a period of not more than (6) six months from the date of delivery, the female worker shall be entitled to one or two breaks per day to breastfeed her child, provided that the two breaks do not exceed an hour.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Sick Leave: during probation
clauses.content: The worker shall not be entitled to a paid sick leave during the probationary period. However, the employer may grant him a sick leave without pay, based on a medical report issued by the medical entity that stipulates the necessity of granting the leave.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Sick Leave: entitlement
clauses.content:
After the end of the probationary period, the worker may be entitled to a sick leave of not more than (90) ninety continuous or intermittent days per year, provided that it is calculated as follows:
a. The first (15) fifteen days with full pay.
b. The following (30) thirty days with half pay.
c. The following period unpaid.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Sick Leave: termination after sick leave
clauses.content: The employer may terminate the worker’s service after finishing his sick leave referred to in this Article if he is unable to return to his work, provided that the worker receives all his financial entitlements in accordance with the provisions of this Decree-Law and its Implementing Regulation.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Various Leaves: bereavement and parental leave
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, January 2024)

clauses.title: Various Leaves: study leave
clauses.content: The worker may be granted a study leave for a period of (10) ten working days per year for the worker who is enrolled or regularly studying at one of the educational institutions approved in the State, in order to sit for exams, provided that the service term at the employer is not less than two years.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, January 2024)

clauses.title: Validity of Notice Period in case of Termination of the Contract during the Leave
clauses.content: If either party to the employment contract wishes to terminate the contract in accordance with the provisions of this Decree-Law and its Implementing Regulation, while the worker is on the leave, the validity of the notice period agreed upon in the employment contract shall not begin, except from the day following the day scheduled for the worker’s return from the leave, unless both parties agree otherwise.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Employment Contract Termination Cases
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, January 2024)

clauses.title: Employment Contract Termination Notice: written notice of 30 to 90 days
clauses.content: Either party to the employment contract may terminate the contract for any legitimate reason, provided that the other party is notified in writing and work shall be performed during the notice period agreed upon in the contract, provided that such period is not less than (30) thirty days and not more than (90) ninety days.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)
clauses.guidance: Either party may end the contract for a legitimate reason with written notice; the notice period agreed in the contract must be between 30 and 90 days.

clauses.title: Employment Contract Termination Notice: notice period terms
clauses.content: The employment contract continues to be valid throughout the notice period referred to in this Article and is terminated upon expiry of such period. The worker shall be entitled to his full wage for that period according to the last wage he was obtaining and he shall work during that period if the employer requests the same from him. It may be agreed upon exemption from the notice period condition or reducing its period while preserving all the rights of the worker for the notice period agreed upon in the employment contract, provided that the notice period is the same for both parties unless it serves the interests of the worker.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)
clauses.guidance: During notice the contract continues at full wage; the notice period must be the same for both parties unless the difference favours the worker.

clauses.title: Employment Contract Termination Notice: pay in lieu of notice
clauses.content: The party who did not abide by the notice period shall pay to the other party compensation, which is called notice period allowance, even if the absence of notification does not cause damage to the other party and the compensation shall be equal to the worker’s wage for the full notice period or the remaining part thereof.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Employment Contract Termination Notice: day off to look for work
clauses.content: If the employment contract is terminated by the employer, the worker shall have the right to be absent during the notice period for one working day without pay per week, in order to search for another job. The worker may specify the day of absence, provided that he notifies the employer of the same (3) three days at least before the absence day.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Cases of the Worker’s Dismissal without Notice
clauses.content:
The employer may dismiss the worker without notice after conducting a written investigation with him and the dismissal decision shall be in writing and justified and the employer or its representative shall hand it over to the worker in any of the following cases:
1. It is proven that the worker impersonated another person, or submitted forged certificates or documents.
2. The worker committed a mistake that resulted in gross physical losses to the employer or he deliberately damaged the properties of the employer and he acknowledged the same, provided that the latter informs the Ministry of the incident within (7) seven working days from the date of being aware of the occurrence of the incident.
3. The worker violated the instructions of the establishment’s by-law related to the safety of work and workers or the workplace, provided that they are written and hung in a visible place and the worker is informed of the same.
4. The worker did not perform his basic duties according to the employment contract and he continued breaching them despite conducting a written investigation with him for this reason and he is notified and warned of dismissal twice if this is repeated.
5. The worker disclosed one work secret related to industrial or intellectual property, which resulted in losses to the employer, missed opportunity or achieving a personal benefit for the worker.
6. The worker is drunk during working hours, is under the influence of narcotics or psychotropic substances, or commits an action breaching the public morals at the workplace.
7. The worker assaults during work, the employer, manager in charge, one of his superiors or colleagues at work, by word, action or any form of assault that is punishable under the legislation in force in the State.
8. The worker is absent without a legitimate reason or excuse accepted by the employer for more than (20) twenty intermittent days during one year or more than (7) seven consecutive days.
9. The worker exploited his position in an illegal way to obtain personal results and gains.
10. The worker joins another establishment without abiding by the rules and procedures prescribed in this regard.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)
clauses.guidance: Summary dismissal without notice is allowed only for the listed causes, after a written investigation, by a written and reasoned decision.

clauses.title: Cases where the Worker quits Work without Notice
clauses.content:
The worker may quit work without notice, while retaining his rights upon end of service in any of the following cases:
1. The employer’s breach of his obligations towards the worker stipulated in the contract, this Decree-Law or the resolutions issued for its implementation, provided that the worker notifies the Ministry fourteen (14) working days before the date of quitting work and without the employer’s rectification and removal of the effects resulting from this breach despite being notified by the Ministry of the same.
2. It has been proven that the employer or its legal representative assaulted the worker, committed violence or harassment against him at work, provided that he informs the competent authorities and the Ministry within (5) five working days from the date on which he was able to report.
3. If there is a grave danger at the workplace that threatens the worker’s safety or health, provided that the employer is aware of its existence and does not take any actions that indicate its removal. Then, the Implementing Regulation hereof specifies the rules of the grave danger.
4. The employer instructs the worker to perform a work fundamentally different from the work agreed upon in the employment contract, without obtaining the worker’s written consent on the same, except for the necessity cases as per the provisions of Article (12) hereof.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Illegitimate Termination of the Worker’s Service: unlawful grounds
clauses.content: The termination of the worker’s service by the employer is unlawful if the termination of the worker’s service is due to filing a serious complaint to the Ministry or filing a lawsuit against the employer, whose validity is proven.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Illegitimate Termination of the Worker’s Service: compensation
clauses.content: The employer shall pay fair compensation to the worker estimated by the competent court if it is proven that the termination is unlawful according to Clause (1) of this Article. The amount of compensation shall be defined by taking into account the work type and the amount of damage caused to the worker and his service term. It is required in all cases that the amount of compensation does not exceed the worker’s wage for a period of (3) three months, calculated according to the last wage he was obtaining.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: End of Service Benefits for Full-Time Workers: gratuity for foreign workers
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)
clauses.guidance: A full-time foreign worker with at least one year of continuous service gets end-of-service gratuity on the basic wage: 21 days for each of the first five years and 30 days for each later year.

clauses.title: End of Service Benefits for Full-Time Workers: part of a year
clauses.content: The foreign worker shall be entitled to a benefit for parts of the year in proportion to the period spent at work, provided that he completed one year of continuous service.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: End of Service Benefits for Full-Time Workers: last basic wage
clauses.content: Without prejudice to the legislation regarding the granting of pensions or retirement benefits to workers in some establishments, the end of service benefits shall be calculated according to the last basic wage the worker was entitled to, with respect to those who receive their wages on a monthly, weekly or daily basis and according to the average daily wage stipulated in the provisions hereof for those who receive their wages on a piecework basis.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: End of Service Benefits for Full-Time Workers: two years’ wage cap
clauses.content: It is required based on the foregoing that the end of service benefits for the foreign worker in its entirety does not exceed two years’ wage.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: End of Service Benefits for Full-Time Workers: deductions from gratuity
clauses.content: The employer may deduct from the end of service benefits any amounts payable under the law or a judgment, in accordance with the conditions and procedures specified in the Implementing Regulation hereof.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Paying the Workers’ Entitlements at the End of the Contract Term
clauses.content: The employer shall pay to the worker, within (14) fourteen days from the end date of the contract term, his wages and all his other entitlements stipulated herein and resolutions issued for its implementation, the contract or the establishment’s by-laws.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Final Provisions: minimum rights
clauses.content: The rights stipulated herein shall represent the minimum rights for workers and the provisions hereof shall not prejudice any of the rights granted to the worker under any other legislation, agreement, acknowledgment, regulation or employment contract, which would grant the worker rights that are more useful than the rights established under the provisions hereof.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)

clauses.title: Final Provisions: contrary terms and waivers void
clauses.content: Each provision contradicting the provisions hereof, even if it was existing prior to its enforcement, shall be deemed null and void, unless it is more beneficial to the worker. Each discharge, reconciliation or waiver of the rights arising for the worker hereunder shall be null and void if it violates its provisions.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)
clauses.guidance: Any contract term that gives the worker less than the law is void, and so is any waiver or settlement of the worker’s statutory rights, unless more beneficial to the worker.

clauses.title: Approved Language: Arabic contract
clauses.content: The employer shall use the Arabic language in concluding contracts with the workers, in writing and publishing instructions and circulars which it shall issue, provided that there shall be another language, beside the Arabic, which is understood by the non-Arabic speaking worker, taking into account that the text in the other language matches the Arabic text. In case of difference, the Arabic text shall prevail.
clauses.source_title: Federal Decree-Law No. (33) of 2021 Regarding the Regulation of Employment Relationships and its amendments (MOHRE consolidated English text, October 2025)
clauses.guidance: Contracts must be in Arabic, with another language the worker understands where needed; the Arabic text prevails.
